title: A fashion sketch becomes a runway walk
pitch: A design drawing in. The real garment, worn by an invented model, walking a runway, with a score out.
why: Every step changes one thing. Krea 2 draws the design, Qwen-Image 2.1 makes it a real garment, the Outfit Swap edit puts it on an invented model, and H3 walks her down the runway.

steps.label: The design
steps.prompt: Fashion design illustration of a long sleeveless dress in deep cobalt blue silk with a high neck and a long flowing skirt, shown on a plain dress form, loose watercolour and ink, plain white paper, no people, no lettering.

steps.label: The real garment

5.prompt: Turn this illustration into a realistic product photograph of the real dress on the same dress form: real cobalt blue silk with natural folds and sheen, plain light grey studio background, soft even light. Keep the design, shape and colour the same.

steps.does: The drawing as a real dress.

steps.label: The model

57:27.text: Full body photograph of an invented tall woman in her late twenties with short black hair, wearing a plain fitted black long-sleeved top and black trousers, standing at the start of a long white runway, arms relaxed at her sides, the whole figure in frame, soft even light.

steps.does: An invented model, whole figure in frame.

steps.label: Worn
steps.model: Qwen-Image 2.1 with the Outfit Swap LoRA
steps.does: The same model wearing the dress.

steps.label: The walk
steps.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Fashion runway film. The woman walks slowly toward the camera down the white runway. The long silk skirt flows with each step. Her arms stay relaxed at her sides. The camera holds still at the end of the runway. One continuous shot, no cuts.

overall_soundscape: Footsteps, a soft room tone.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
